description: This file defines the AzureQueueOptions class, which provides configuration options for an Azure Queue Stream provider in Orleans. It includes properties and methods for setting up the QueueServiceClient, configuring credentials, and validation logic. It also defines a validator class for configuration validation.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptions
classes.description: Provides configuration options for Azure Queue Stream provider, including client setup and credential configuration.

classes.name: AzureQueueOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the AzureQueueOptions configuration, ensuring credentials and queue names are properly set.

methods.name: ConfigureQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Sets up the QueueServiceClient using various credential methods such as connection string, URI, token credential, SAS credential, or shared key credential.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the necessary credentials are configured and if queue names are specified.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a validator instance for given service provider and name.
